spec.description: The twice-daily narrative forecast for one grid cell: about a dozen named periods (`Tonight`, `Wednesday`, `Wednesday Night`) covering the next week, each with a temperature, a wind, and a sentence of prose.

request.title: GetForecastRequest
request.description: Which grid cell, and in which units.

office.description: Three-letter forecast office code addressing the grid, such as `SEW`. `points.get_point` returns it as `gridId`.

units.description: Unit system for the rendered temperatures: `us` for Fahrenheit and miles per hour, `si` for Celsius and kilometres per hour. Defaults to `us`.

response.title: ForecastFeature
response.description: The forecast, in the GeoJSON feature the API wraps it in. The geometry is the outline of the grid cell, which the caller already named, so the client hands back `properties`.

geometry.description: Outline of the grid cell the forecast covers.

notes: `periods[].temperature` is a bare number beside a `temperatureUnit` string, not the `QuantitativeValue` the rest of the API uses. That is the wire, so that is the type.
